description:
[Game reference] Rust game modes compared (Vanilla, Softcore, Hardcore, Primitive) and the Era system. `compare`: rule-by-rule table (`values` in the order of `modes`: vanilla, softcore, hardcore, primitive; only rules
that differ). `modes`: each mode's own added/removed/changed feature text from the game, the ConVars it sets (`value`
vs `default`, with `help`), and its tech tree per workbench. `hardcore_items`: the 37 items Hardcore restricts with
`how` (Loot only = can't be crafted, researched or bought; Not sold; Removed) and `allowed` sources. `eras`: server.era
values and the items tagged with each era (a server set to an era can't loot, craft or buy items of a later era).
`recipe_overrides`, `era_vending`, `era_missions`, `era_loot`: what Primitive changes. `test_modes`: round-based modes
in the files that no normal server runs. With `item=`: `{item, name, hardcore, era, primitive_recipe}` (null parts
don't apply). Use mode=hardcore etc. for one mode's differences from vanilla, item=<shortname> for an item's Hardcore/era status. Link https://rust.wiki/game-modes.

item.description: An item shortname: just that item's Hardcore and era status.
